text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Justice Minister Abderrahman Amalu pays surprise visit to prison in Sale, twin city of Rabat.
- Morocco's 1996 imports fell 0.7 percent compared with the year before because of a drop in raw and semi-processed products and industrial equipment.
- Tourism Minister Mohamed Alaoui M'hamedi says the sector needs structural reforms.
- Director of agency for the development of northern provinces meets the European Union ambassador in Morocco to discuss EU help to create small and medium-sized firms.
- Socialist party (Union Socialiste des Forces Populaires) cautious about authorities' proposal to sign a convention with Casablanca to tackle social and economic problems.
